description: Source code implementing SHA1-summed file write infrastructure with functions for hashing, flushing, finalizing, and verifying hash files, used in Git for data integrity.

classes.name: struct hashfile
classes.description: Data structure representing a hash file with buffers, context, file descriptors, and associated metadata.

classes.name: struct hashfile_checkpoint
classes.description: Structure for checkpointing hashfile state during write operations.

methods.name: verify_buffer_or_die
methods.description: Verifies buffer content against the check buffer, terminates on error.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Writes buffer to file, verifying if check_fd is set.

methods.name: hashflush
methods.description: Flushes current buffer, updating hash if needed.

methods.name: free_hashfile
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a hashfile structure.

methods.name: finalize_hashfile
methods.description: Finalizes hash computation, writes result, and closes files.

methods.name: discard_hashfile
methods.description: Closes file descriptors and frees hashfile structure.

methods.name: hashwrite
methods.description: Writes data to hashfile, updating hash and buffer.

methods.name: hashfd_check
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with a check file descriptor.

methods.name: hashfd_internal
methods.description: Internal function to create hashfile with specified buffer size and progress.

methods.name: hashfd
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with default large buffer size.

methods.name: hashfd_throughput
methods.description: Creates a hashfile optimized for throughput with smaller buffer size.

methods.name: hashfile_checkpoint
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of current hashfile state.

methods.name: hashfile_checksum_valid
methods.description: Validates checksum of data against stored hash.
